recommended_next_phase: Independent verification of HRAC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/HATP_REMOTE_ASSERTION_CEREMONY_CONTRACT.md), before any RP-ID/TLS infrastructure selection or implementation begins.
summary: Contract-freeze-only phase, following Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N.8's recommendation. Read HRWP-001 v1.0 (68 requirements) and HSCE-001 v1.3 (84 requirements) fresh from primary contract text, plus the exact current synchronous hatp_signing_ceremony.py orchestrator, to freeze a new companion contract -- HRAC-001 v1.0 ('HATP Remote Assertion Ceremony Contract', docs/contracts/HATP_REMOTE_ASSERTION_CEREMONY_CONTRACT.md, 76 requirements) -- defining the asynchronous request/response/evidence-capture orchestration layer both predecessor contracts named (HRWP-REQ-060, HSCE-001's own neighboring text) but declined to resolve. Froze: a closed 7-state request state machine (PENDING/RESPONSE_RECEIVED/VERIFIED/COMPLETED/EXPIRED/FAILED/CANCELLED, deliberately narrower than the 9-state menu offered, with terminal-state closure); a random (not content-addressed) request_id scheme explicitly distinguished from HSCE-001's own evidence_id digest convention; a canonical challenge-construction and SHA-256-digest scheme with a fixed domain-separation string (PCAE/HATP/HRAC/SIGN/V1); one-time consumption reusing HSCE-REQ-052's exact atomic hard-link exclusive-publish technique, generalized to any number of concurrent responses; a closed 12-member failure taxonomy; explicit server-restart/durability semantics (non-terminal requests do not survive restart, an explicit v1.0 choice); an additive remote-evidence-record schema that never widens HSCE-001's own closed four-field envelope schema; privacy-minimization and sign-counter/UP-UV evidence rules; a trusted-kernel/adapter boundary and future-HMIC-impact statement; a required security-test/synthetic-interoperability gate; and an explicit implementation-prerequisite DAG. Confirmed HSCE-001 requires no version bump (every reused concept unchanged, every new concept additive). Carried forward, explicitly not resolved, Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N.8's protocol_name/HRWP-REQ-019 Non-Blocking finding, with this contract's own explicit statement that its internal coherence does not depend on that finding's resolution -- only real credential enrollment does. 13 freshly authored disposable tests, all passing. No production source (src/pcae/, scripts/) changed. No existing contract (HRWP-001, HSCE-001, HATP-001, HPSE-001, HBDC-001) amended -- HRAC-001 is purely additive. No makeCredential/getAssertion invoked anywhere. Verdict: HRAC-001 v1.0 FROZEN -- NOT YET INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED, NOT IMPLEMENTED.
